d:
Munger Deepotsav : munger ke prasiddh bari durga maharani mandir men bhavy dipotsav ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri is dipotsav ka shubharanbh chandi ka dip jalakar karenge. mandir parisar men dipon ki roshni aur bhavy aayojan ko lekar khas taiyariyan ki gaee hain.
Dekhie munger ke bari durga maharani mandir se dipotsav ki khas tasviren
